source: Saskatchewan Ministry of Energy and Resources, Petroleum Wells (ArcGIS REST layer, Production Data Warehouse)
note: Atlas grouping of Saskatchewan Petroleum Wells FLUID_CAT and MODE_: producing = OIL or GAS category and MODE_ ACTIVE; shut-in = SUSPENDED or NON-ACTIVE; plugged = any ABD* or PARTLY ABND mode; injection/disposal = FLUID_CAT INJECTION or DISPOSAL while active, non-active or suspended; other = licensed, cased, completed, cancelled, stratigraphic/potash tests, water-source.
